title: SXTN Component Index
description: Validates the YAML Component Index emitted by sxtn-component-indexer. Each entry represents a discovered interactive component in frontend code. Duplicate component_id values surface in consistency_gate, not as entry drops.

NotificationBlock.description: Optional push/toast notification config linked to this component's action.

action.description: Optional deep-link action triggered by the notification

delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before notification fires

ComponentEntry.description: One discovered interactive component. index_key is globally unique; component_id is semantic and may repeat across entries (triggers consistency_gate).

index_key.description: Globally unique key: <featureList>-<monotonic-timestamp>. Entries are SORTED by this key. Pattern: kebab-case feature prefix + hyphen + 18-digit timestamp+sequence suffix (14-digit UTC timestamp + 4-digit sequence for monotonic uniqueness within a run).

component_id.description: Semantic component identifier: <element>.<feature>.<action>. e.g. button.task.create. A duplicate across entries triggers a consistency_gate warning.

feature.description: Feature name derived from filename or component context

tier.description: Feature tier. Defaults to 'default' when not derivable from source.

module.description: Module owning this component, derived from filename or directory

parent.description: Optional parent component_id (e.g. popup.task.edit contains button.task.create). Must match component_id pattern.

telemetry_event_id.description: Optional analytics/telemetry event identifier to fire when this component is activated

ConsistencyFinding.description: A consistency-gate finding: same component_id appeared in multiple entries (same UX must reuse one component).

occurrences.description: All index_keys that share this component_id

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the index was generated

source_dir.description: Absolute or relative path to the scanned source directory

entries.description: Component entries, sorted ascending by index_key

consistency_gate.description: Duplicate component_id findings. Empty array = no duplicates (clean). Non-empty = consistency violations that MUST be resolved before promotion.
